name: Table 2-31: Miracles of the Dark Age
_doc: Roll for an Ancient Miracle artefact. On 10 (Multiple Blessings) roll twice more (re-rolling further 10s and duplicates) and apply both.

rows.name: Imposing
rows.description: Visibly wrought with long-forgotten heraldry and emblems of a past age, inspiring fearful awe.

rows.name: Steady
rows.description: Rugged and unfailingly dependable under sub-optimal conditions.

rows.name: Potent
rows.description: Powerfully built, performing above and beyond modern equivalents.

rows.name: Swirling Energy
rows.description: Wreathed in a precisely-calibrated energy field, made with long-forgotten techniques.

rows.name: Incalculable Precision
rows.description: Crafted to a meticulousness modern artisans cannot hope to replicate.

rows.name: Indestructible
rows.description: Shaped from an arcane material that defies analysis and damage alike.

rows.name: Multiple Blessings
rows.description: Roll again twice on this table (re-rolling further 10s and duplicates) and apply both results.
